detail.longDescription: 🐘 NEW: Scientists in # Thailand tested 16 Asian elephants with a "detour" puzzle that required them to ignore an obvious but ineffective path to # fruit . The # elephants learned to use a side opening instead, then adjusted when the setup changed. Older elephants adapted more slowly. The findings add to # research on elephant cognition and may help efforts to reduce human-elephant conflict around farms and barriers. 👉 https://www. popsci.com/environment/smart-e lephants-look-before-they-leap/ # animals # science # behavior # wildlife # conservation # asia # nature
